name: Agent sandbox
description: Egress allowlist firewall, restricted sudo and persistent Claude Code state for running coding agents with permission prompts disabled.

allowedDomains.description: Comma-separated extra domains to allow (subdomains included).

allowHostNetwork.description: Allow traffic to the Docker host's /24 network.

restrictSudo.description: Remove the remote user's sudo rights except running the firewall script.

allowClaudeAiConnectors.description: Keep claude.ai connectors (Gmail, Drive, ...) enabled inside the container.

connectorAskRules.description: Comma-separated permission rules that always prompt (even with --dangerously-skip-permissions) when claude.ai connectors are allowed. Defaults cover write-style connector tools.
